subject: Next steps: NovaPulse onboarding & kickoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@novapulse.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@novapulse.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: NovaPulse onboarding & kickoff

Hi Priyom / Lauren —

Great call yesterday with Elena and Samir. Quick handoff note so CS has context and we can pick a kickoff window this week:

Deal highlights / constraints (TL;DR)
- Product: embeddings + chat generative flow for clinician search, expect ~150k tokens/day after q2 ramp.
- Contract: 12-month commitment, committed throughput tier 2 with burst.
- Security: customer requires SOC 2 report and VPC private deployment option on their Azure tenancy (we committed to provide docs & PoC checklist).
- Timeline ask from customer: initial demo + integration checklist review by Mar 8; production data flow in pilot by end of April.

Attached is the initial mutual action plan (MAP) and the tech integration checklist I used in the demo. Key asks for CS to own: kickoff scheduling, integration POC owner, and tracking the SOC2 evidence pack request.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Priyom — own kickoff scheduling and primary CS lead (assign CSM + AM if you think we need both).
2) Lauren — help escalate the SOC2 request and confirm whether we can surface the private deployment runbook this week.
3) I will loop in Solutions Engineer (SE) for an integration deep-dive; suggest Mar 4 or 5 for a 60-min technical kickoff.

Availability: I'm available Mar 3 after 2pm PT. Elena / Samir — feel free to propose times if those are tight.

Attachments:
- NovaPulse-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
- technical-integration-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0189

From: Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@novapulse.com>

Cc: Samir Shah <samir.shah@novapulse.com>, procurement@novapulse.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: NovaPulse onboarding & kickoff

Hi Marcus / Priyom —

Thanks for the summary, Marcus. Quick clarifications from our side:
- SOC2 scope: we need the Type II report + details on encryption-in-transit and at-rest. Can the SOC2 pack include the KMS/HSM integration notes?
- Pilot dataset: we’ll start with a subset of de-identified clinician notes (approx 10K records) for the pilot.
- Internal stakeholders: I’ll bring our integration lead Samir and procurement on the kickoff. Procurement will need the SOW redline before we commit to a date.

Proposed kickoff windows: Mar 4 (10–11am PT) or Mar 5 (2–3pm PT). Either works for us.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Elena
VP Product, NovaPulse Health
elena.morgan@novapulse.com

Thanks Marcus — happy to take point on this. I’ll be primary CSM and will lead the kickoff. Proposed plan and owners:

Looping in a couple of quick items from the GTM side:

1) SOC2 & Security pack — I checked with security ops; we can provide a redacted Type II report and a short note on KMS/HSM integration. Priyom, I’ll share the Pack link to the drive and flag any outstanding artifacts that need legal review.

2) SLA & committed throughput — procurement will want the exact burst behavior documented. Marcus, can you confirm the committed TPS and burst policy (I recall tier 2 with 3x burst for short windows)? I want this on the kickoff slide.

3) CSM handover doc — Priyom, please capture these owners in the CS intake doc (link below) and include a tentative 8-week onboarding milestone plan.

CS intake doc (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-novapulse-onboarding
